items.title_en: ‘I don’t want to save the brand’: Gaurav Taneja reacts to boycott calls over Mau’s death
items.title_zh: “我不想拯救这个品牌”：Gaurav Taneja 对抵制 Mau 之死的呼吁做出反应
items.summary_en: Gaurav Taneja said he planned to discuss Mau during his September 29 farm visit but addressed the controversy earlier after allegations about the dog spread online.
items.summary_zh: 高拉夫·塔内贾 (Gaurav Taneja) 表示，他计划在 9 月 29 日参观农场期间讨论 Mau，但在有关这只狗的指控在网上传播后，他早些时候解决了这一争议。

items.title_en: Top 10 youngest billionaires in India 2026: Zepto’s Kaivalya Vohra remains India’s youngest billionaire at 23
items.title_zh: 2026 年印度最年轻的 10 位亿万富翁：Zepto 的 Kaivalya Vohra 仍是印度最年轻的亿万富翁，年仅 23 岁
items.summary_en: Zepto's co-founder Kaivalya Vohra topped M3M Hurun India Rich list while Cupid's Aditya Kumar Halwasiya is the fastest wealth creator in 2026.
items.summary_zh: Zepto 的联合创始人 Kaivalya Vohra 荣登 M3M 胡润印度富豪榜榜首，而 Cupid 的 Aditya Kumar Halwasiya 则是 2026 年最快的财富创造者。

items.title_en: 26-year-old turns travel passion into career, earns up to Rs 2.88 lakh per trip
items.title_zh: 26 岁年轻人将旅行热情变成职业，每次旅行收入高达 28.8 万卢比
items.summary_en: From Instagram partnerships to leading group tours, Rhiannon Wood has built a travel career after years of minimum-wage jobs.
items.summary_zh: 从 Instagram 合作伙伴到领导团体旅游，Rhiannon Wood 在从事多年的最低工资工作后建立了旅游职业生涯。

items.title_en: Kutta Singh vs Mahakutteshwar: Delhi’s ‘fat dog’ contest sparks online campaign wars
items.title_zh: 库塔·辛格 vs 马哈库特什瓦尔：德里的“肥狗”竞赛引发在线竞选大战
items.summary_en: ‘Fat Dogs of Delhi’, an Instagram page dedicated to the city’s chubby canines, has launched an online competition featuring 64 dogs.
items.summary_zh: “德里的胖狗”是一个专门针对该市胖乎乎的狗狗的 Instagram 页面，发起了一项由 64 只狗参加的在线比赛。
